research.title: Partial Pooling for Regression Uncertainty in Sparse Subgroups
bullets: Formulated the question of how subgroup sample scarcity affects residual variance estimation and led development of an empirical Bayes pooling approach.
Compared pooled, subgroup-specific, and shrinkage estimators on simulated heteroskedastic data, examining interval coverage and sensitivity to misspecified subgroup structure.

research.title: Stabilized Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated a research question about unstable importance weights and led development of a clipped, density-ratio-weighted conformal procedure for regression under covariate shift.
Investigated clipping and residual normalization through controlled shift experiments, comparing empirical coverage, interval width, and sensitivity to density-ratio estimation errors.

publications.title: Clipped Importance Weights for Conformal Regression Under Covariate Shift
Residual Normalization and Density-Ratio Error in Weighted Conformal Prediction

projects.title: Kernel and Tree-Based Regression Comparisons
bullets: Implemented a comparative regression pipeline using kernel ridge regression and random forests, with standardized preprocessing and cross-validation for hyperparameter selection.
Compared held-out prediction errors across smooth and discontinuous response functions, examining sensitivity to irrelevant features and training sample availability.

projects.title: Post-Hoc Calibration of Probabilistic Classifiers
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and isotonic calibration for neural and logistic classifiers, separating model fitting, calibration, and evaluation data.
Compared reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and log loss under class imbalance, examining how calibration sample size affected probability estimates.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Estimation and Initialization Sensitivity
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance structures, including covariance regularization and convergence checks.
Compared random and clustering-based initializations on overlapping synthetic mixtures, evaluating held-out likelihood, assignment stability, and sensitivity to component specification.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso regression and compared its solutions with ridge and elastic net baselines using matched validation splits.
Evaluated prediction error and feature selection stability across correlated synthetic designs, tracking how regularization choices changed coefficient sparsity.
